context.transcript:
Hi Molly, how was your trip to meet with Xavier Retailers?
Oh, hi Brian.
It went really well.
The retailer really liked our women's footwear line and they've decided to place an order with us for their department stores nationwide.
So it's much bigger than we expected.
Wow, congratulations.
Thanks.
Of course, I know you did most of the market analysis.
It really helped me convince the client to carry our footwear.
Don't worry, it was my pleasure.
Oh, just so you know, there's been a policy change and the receipts from trips can be submitted electronically.
Thanks.
I'll take care of that this week.

这家零售商非常喜欢我们的女士鞋类产品线，他们决定为全国的部门商店向我们下订单。
所以比我们预期的要大得多。
哇，恭喜你。
谢谢。
当然，我知道大部分市场分析是你做的。
这真的帮我说服了客户携带我们的鞋类产品。
别担心，这是我的荣幸。
哦，只是让你知道，政策有变动，出差的收据现在可以电子提交了。
谢谢。
我这周会处理好的。
